name: list_tables
description: List the governed tables you may query, with layer, grain, description and columns. Call this before writing SQL if you are unsure of a column name. Gold tables are the data products to prefer for answers.

name: run_sql
description: Run one read-only SELECT over the governed tables and return up to 50 rows. Name tables as namespace.table, e.g. gold.ba_daily_energy. Use portable SQL that works on both DuckDB and Athena: DATE 'YYYY-MM-DD' literals, round(), avg(), GROUP BY, ORDER BY, LIMIT. Tables above the caller's clearance are refused.

name: describe_table
description: Catalog entry for one table: owner, classification, primary key, quality rules, upstream lineage and consumers. Use it to say which governed table backs a number and who owns it.

name: lookup_entity
description: Resolve names in free text (balancing authorities and their aliases such as 'California ISO' or 'ERCOT', regions, interconnections, energy sources, business terms) to knowledge-graph entities, with codes and facts such as generation mix.

name: search_documents
description: Semantic search over knowledge-base passages: daily facts per balancing authority, cross-BA rankings, reliability summaries and table catalog entries. Optional exact-match filters narrow the search.
